prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Interactive Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pick friend screen into a interactive carousel layout highlighting companion personalities and desktop animations.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Friend"}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Compact Overview Redesign: Redesign the intro story screen into a compact layout with brief story cards detailing what pets do on the desktop.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion"}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Style Selection Screen: Insert a new style selection screen in the adoption flow to let users pick visual artistic styles for their pet.
   config: {"new_custom_style": {"headline": "Select Companion Art Style", "body": "Choose the look and feel for your desktop pet before setting up.", "layout": "grid"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_custom_style", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Background Waiting Experience Interactive Flow: Rebuild the waiting screen into an interactive flow featuring desktop tips, progress updates, and completion alerts.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Sync Clarification Copy: Add clear copy explaining that signing in saves your companion progress and prevents pet loss on restart.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Sign in to keep your desktop companion saved and accessible across all your devices."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Tip Callout: Display a helpful hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit subject photos.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos of your subject facing forward."}}
6: [finish, hint] Home Intro Pet Controls Quick Hint: Add a clear hint on the final home intro screen explaining how to summon, move, or minimize the pet from the taskbar tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to hide, summon, or interact with your pet."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Options Bonus Animation Badge: Add playful feature badges to each path option on the path selection screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Instant Ready Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Time Estimate Notice: Show an estimated setup duration indicator on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Finalizing your adoption certificate takes under 1 minute."}}
9: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Trouble Notification Assistance: Trigger a helpful tip notification if a user spends more than 15 seconds on the sign-in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "Having trouble signing in? Check your internet connection or try re-launching."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick friend screen into an interactive carousel maintains the step's core job and adheres to all base rules.
Compact layout redesign of the story screen retains pet introduction functionality without violating any onboarding constraints.
Inserting a new visual style selection screen into onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4 and retains all required steps.
Enhancing the waiting screen experience with progress updates and tips maintains the core job of showing pet creation.
Adding explanatory sign-in copy regarding device sync and pet saving is informative and compliant.
Adding a helpful lighting tip callout on the photo upload screen complies with all base rules.
Adding a usage tip callout to the home intro overlay is allowed within onboarding.
Adding decorative feature badges to path selection options preserves both choices and complies with fair design rules.
Adding a estimated duration notice on the adoption certificate screen preserves the core screen functionality and fair design standards.
Triggering a helpful sign-in assistance notification after a delay is an acceptable onboarding refinement.
